entries.grounds: At L281-282 `if how is None: return ('current',)` -> `return None`. _group's only caller is _grounds (grep '_group(' over aisef2/ validation/ tests/: def L277 + call L306 only). _grounds does keys={name:_group(...)}; groups by dict.fromkeys(keys.values()); for each key emits _ground(assessed.get(repr), key) plus the contract list. None and ('current',) are both 1-length sentinels; neither can equal any non-None how's 6-tuple, so the partition {how-None contracts} | {per-6-tuple groups} is byte-identical.
